job.title: Interaction Designer
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced Interaction Designer to support a high-profile, sensitive digital programme within UK Central Government.

You will be helping to design accessible, user-centred digital services for individuals and families affected by sensitive circumstances.

This role requires strong interaction design expertise, a thorough understanding of Government Digital Service (GDS) standards and the ability to approach complex user needs with sensitivity. The role is predominantly remote, with travel to Newcastle approximately twice per month.

Key Responsibilities & Experience:

  • Strong experience in Interaction Design.
  • Experience working within multidisciplinary Agile teams.
  • Excellent knowledge of GDS standards and accessibility requirements.
  • Experience designing accessible, user-centred digital services.
  • Strong prototyping skills, ideally using Figma and/or the GOV.UK Prototype Kit.
  • Experience collaborating closely with User Researchers, Content Designers and Service Designers.
  • Ability to work sensitively on services supporting vulnerable users.
  • Previous experience working within UK Central Government is highly desirable.

job.title: Solution Architect
job.description:
An opportunity has arisen for a skilled Solution Architect to play a key role in a large-scale digital initiative within UK Central Government.

Working in a complex technical environment, you will help shape architectural approaches, contribute to solution design and ensure alignment with established governance frameworks and technical standards.

We are particularly interested in individuals with expertise in AI technologies, hands-on experience with Abacus and a strong command of ArchiMate modelling. Familiarity with the challenges of delivering technology solutions within the public sector will also be important.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide senior-level solution architecture expertise across a complex digital programme.
  • Support the design and development of robust solution architectures.
  • Apply AI knowledge and architecture experience to support technical solutions.
  • Use Abacus and ArchiMate for architecture modelling.
  • Develop and communicate solution architecture across complex technology environments.
  • Engage with stakeholders and support architecture governance activities.


Key Skills & Experience:

  • Strong knowledge of AI technologies and experience in solution architecture.
  • Experience using Abacus.
  • Strong knowledge of ArchiMate architecture modelling.
  • Proven experience developing and communicating solution architecture within complex technology environments.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and architecture governance experience.
  • Previous architecture experience within a major UK Government department is highly desirable.
  • Previous UK Central Government experience is advantageous.
  • SC clearance preferred.

job.title: User Researcher
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced User Researcher to support an established digital programme and be responsible for planning and delivering user research to understand user needs, behaviours and challenges. You'll be using findings to help shape the design and delivery of effective digital services.

The role involves working closely with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders, ensuring that user needs and research evidence are embedded throughout service design and development.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Plan and conduct user research to understand user needs, behaviours and challenges.
  • Select and apply appropriate qualitative and quantitative research methods.
  • Analyse research findings and translate them into clear, actionable insights.
  • Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary digital delivery teams.
  • Engage with stakeholders to communicate research findings and insights.
  • Ensure user needs and research evidence inform service design and development.

Key Skills & Experience:

  • Active SC clearance is required.
  • Strong experience planning and conducting user research.
  • Experience selecting and applying appropriate qualitative and quantitative research methods.
  • Ability to analyse research findings and translate them into clear, actionable insights.
  • Experience working within multidisciplinary digital delivery teams.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
  • Previous Government or public sector experience is highly desirable.

job.title: User Researcher
job.description:
We are looking for a User Researcher to be responsible for planning, conducting and analysing user research, working with stakeholders and wider User-Centred Design teams to help inform improvements to digital services.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead discovery interviews with stakeholders.
  • Attend cross-UCD community meetings, calls and design critiques.
  • Prepare research and ethics plans.
  • Recruit participants for user research activities.
  • Observe and take notes during user research sessions.
  • Conduct interviews with research participants.
  • Analyse research data and identify key findings.
  • Prepare user research reports.
  • Present research findings to stakeholders.
  • Gather feedback from research requestors.
  • Create and iterate research artefacts.
  • Design research-based improvements using prototypes or by making content changes through browser developer tools.


Working Arrangements

The team operates predominantly remotely, with attendance required for one team day per month to encourage collaboration and team cohesion.

job.title: Business Analyst
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to work closely with government stakeholders and wider delivery teams to understand business needs, capture and analyse requirements, and translate these into clear requirements for technical and delivery teams.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Engage with stakeholders to understand business needs and requirements.
  • Gather, analyse and document business requirements.
  • Facilitate workshops and discussions with key stakeholders.
  • Translate business requirements into clear technical and delivery requirements.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary delivery teams.
  • Support effective communication between business stakeholders and technical teams.


Key Skills & Experience:

  • Active SC clearance is required.
  • Strong Business Analysis experience within complex digital or technology programmes.
  • Proven experience in requirements gathering, analysis and documentation.
  • Experience in stakeholder engagement and workshop facilitation.
  • Ability to translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements for technical and delivery teams.
  • Experience working within multidisciplinary delivery environments.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Previous experience within UK Central Government is beneficial.

job.title: Interaction Designer
job.description:
Are you an Interaction Designer who enjoys solving complex challenges and turning complicated processes into simple, seamless user experiences?

We're recruiting for an exciting opportunity to influence the redesign of established digital services as part of a significant modernisation programme. You'll have the freedom to explore new approaches, challenge existing ways of working and bring ideas to life through wireframes, prototypes and user testing.

Working alongside a team of digital specialists, you'll help define practical, accessible solutions that improve how people interact with essential online services.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Create, develop and iterate interaction designs based on user needs, research findings and service requirements.
  • Analyse existing user journeys and identify opportunities to improve usability, accessibility and overall user experience.
  • Develop user flows, wireframes and interactive prototypes to communicate potential design solutions.
  • Design intuitive interactions for complex transactional services and end-to-end digital journeys.
  • Collaborate closely with User Researchers to test, validate and refine design concepts using real user feedback.
  • Work alongside Service Designers and Content Designers to deliver coherent, joined-up user experiences.
  • Engage with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Architects and Engineering teams to understand technical constraints, dependencies and delivery considerations.
  • Ensure designs align with accessibility standards, inclusive design principles and established government design guidelines.
  • Contribute design evidence, insights and recommendations to discovery outputs and future delivery options.


Skills & Experience Required:

  • Proven experience as an Interaction Designer within Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
  • Strong background designing complex digital services, transactional platforms or large-scale transformation programmes.
  • Demonstrable experience supporting discovery phases and exploring future service design options.
  • Excellent skills in interaction design, user flows, wireframing and prototyping.
  • Strong understanding of accessibility, inclusive design and user-centred design principles.
  • Experience using user research, usability testing and evidence to inform and iterate designs.
  • Ability to simplify complex processes, business requirements and technical challenges into intuitive digital experiences.
  • Experience working within multidisciplinary digital delivery teams.
  • Strong collaboration skills.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement, communication and problem-solving capabilities.


Desirable Experience:

  • Previous experience working on government or public sector digital transformation programmes.
  • Familiarity with Government Digital Service (GDS) standards and the GOV.UK Design System.
  • Experience designing services within large, complex or highly regulated organisations.
  • Understanding of WCAG accessibility standards and inclusive interaction design practices.
  • Experience modernising legacy digital services or supporting migration to new platforms.
  • Experience designing services involving multiple user groups, intermediaries or complex end-to-end journeys.

job.title: Service Designer
job.description:
Are you an experienced Service Designer who thrives on untangling complex services and finding smarter, more effective ways to connect people, processes and technology?

We're recruiting for an exciting opportunity to help reimagine established digital services as part of a major public sector modernisation programme. You'll take a holistic view of how services operate, uncover challenges across interconnected systems and explore opportunities to create more seamless experiences for different user groups.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Map and analyse complex end-to-end service journeys, including interactions between different user groups and digital platforms.
  • Identify pain points, service gaps, dependencies and opportunities for improvement across existing services.
  • Develop service blueprints, journey maps, process flows and visual artefacts to communicate current and future service models.
  • Collaborate closely with User Researchers to ensure service design decisions are informed by evidence and genuine user needs.
  • Work alongside Interaction Designers and Content Designers to create coherent, accessible and joined-up experiences.
  • Plan and facilitate workshops with business, technical and programme stakeholders to explore challenges and potential solutions.
  • Engage with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Architects and Engineering teams to understand operational constraints, technical dependencies and delivery considerations.
  • Assess how existing digital capabilities and platforms could be reused or enhanced to support future services.
  • Contribute service design insights, evidence and recommendations to discovery outputs and future delivery options.


Skills & Experience:

  • Proven experience as a Service Designer working within Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
  • Strong background designing and improving complex digital services or supporting large-scale transformation programmes.
  • Demonstrable experience mapping end-to-end services, user journeys and interconnected processes.
  • Excellent service blueprinting, journey mapping and workshop facilitation skills.
  • Experience identifying dependencies and relationships across multiple services, systems, teams and organisations.
  • Strong ability to use user research, data and evidence to inform service design decisions.
  • Experience simplifying complex service landscapes and communicating findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with User Researchers, Interaction Designers and Content Designers.
  • Experience contributing to discovery phases, exploring service improvement opportunities and shaping recommendations for future delivery.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.


Desirable Experience:

  • Previous experience working on government or public sector digital transformation programmes.
  • Familiarity with Government Digital Service (GDS) standards and user-centred design principles.
  • Experience modernising legacy services or supporting the transition to new digital platforms.
  • Understanding of complex transactional services involving multiple user groups or intermediaries.
  • Experience working across highly integrated, regulated or large-scale service environments.
  • Knowledge of service blueprinting techniques and tools such as Miro, Figma or similar collaborative design platforms.

job.title: Content Designer
job.description:
An exciting opportunity for an experienced Content Designer to play a key role in shaping accessible, user-centred content for complex digital services within a major public sector transformation programme.

We are looking for a skilled Content Designer to join a multidisciplinary Agile Scrum team, supporting a critical discovery phase focused on understanding user needs, reviewing existing content journeys and identifying opportunities to improve the overall digital service experience.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Analyse complex user needs and translate them into clear, accessible and user-focused content.
  • Review and assess existing content across complex transactional and digital service journeys.
  • Identify content gaps, duplication, inconsistencies and opportunities for improvement or reuse.
  • Collaborate closely with User Researchers to ensure content decisions are informed by evidence and user insights.
  • Work alongside Service Designers and Interaction Designers to create coherent end-to-end user journeys.
  • Create, prototype, test and iterate content throughout the discovery phase.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Architects and Engineering teams to understand technical constraints and dependencies.
  • Apply content design best practices, accessibility standards and plain English principles.
  • Contribute content expertise, findings and recommendations to discovery outputs and future delivery options.


Skills & Experience Required:

  • Proven experience as a Content Designer within Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
  • Strong background designing content for complex digital services or large-scale transformation programmes.
  • Demonstrable experience supporting discovery phases and shaping content strategies for future delivery.
  • Experience designing user-centred content across complex transactional journeys.
  • Excellent understanding of accessibility and inclusive content design.
  • Experience using user research, usability testing and evidence to inform and iterate content.
  • Ability to simplify complex information, processes and technical concepts into clear, engaging content.
  • Experience working within multidisciplinary digital teams.
  • Strong collaboration skills, particularly when working with User Researchers, Service Designers and Interaction Designers.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement, communication and problem-solving skills.

  • Previous experience working on government or public sector digital transformation programmes.

  • Experience designing content for complex, regulated or highly integrated digital services.

  • Experience supporting services involving multiple user groups, intermediaries or complex end-to-end journeys.

job.title: Business Analyst

We are looking for a skilled Business Analyst to join a multidisciplinary Agile Scrum team, supporting a critical discovery phase focused on understanding existing services, identifying opportunities for improvement and defining viable solutions for future delivery.

This is an excellent opportunity to work on a high-profile digital transformation programme, collaborating with business and technical specialists to influence strategic decisions and shape future services.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and facilitate discovery workshops with business, technical and programme stakeholders.
  • Gather, analyse and document complex business and technical requirements.
  • Map user journeys, business processes, system dependencies and capability gaps.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Architects, UX Designers, Researchers and Engineering teams.

job.title: Service Designer
job.description:
An experienced Service Designer is required to join a major UK Central Government transformation programme, working on complex services used by citizens and operational teams.

The assignment will focus on understanding how services operate end-to-end and identifying opportunities to simplify journeys, address pain points and improve the experience across digital and non-digital channels.

You’ll be joining an established multidisciplinary environment and working across the wider service landscape rather than focusing solely on individual products or touchpoints. Experience designing services involving vulnerable or hard-to-reach users would be particularly valuable.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Mapping current and future-state services across multiple channels and touchpoints
  • Developing service blueprints, journey maps and other service design artefacts
  • Bringing together user, operational, policy and business perspectives to identify opportunities for improvement
  • Facilitating workshops to explore problems, test assumptions and develop potential service solutions
  • Working alongside User Researchers to turn research evidence into service improvements
  • Collaborating with Product, Delivery, Business Analysis and Architecture colleagues
  • Helping teams understand dependencies, pain points and gaps across end-to-end journeys
  • Presenting service concepts and recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Contributing throughout discovery, alpha, beta and live phases
  • Supporting teams in applying GDS and UCD principles in practice


What We’re Looking For

  • Extensive experience producing and evolving service blueprints
  • Strong journey mapping and end-to-end service mapping capability
  • The ability to make complex services understandable through clear visualisation
  • Experience facilitating workshops involving diverse and senior stakeholder groups
  • Confidence navigating complex operational and organisational environments
  • Experience working as part of multidisciplinary agile teams
  • An evidence-led approach to service design and decision-making
  • Strong communication and stakeholder influencing skills
  • Knowledge of GDS standards, UCD practices and government service assessments would be advantageous, as would experience working on large-scale citizen-facing or operational services.

  • Strong experience delivering research across complex digital transformation programmes
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Experience working within multidisciplinary agile delivery teams

  • Strong workshop and facilitation skills
  • Experience managing multiple stakeholder groups and competing priorities
  • Confidence presenting findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders

job.title: Platform Security Engineer (AWS)
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced Platform Security Engineer for a role that combines hands-on engineering with consultancy, helping internal teams adopt secure-by-design approaches while developing and maintaining security tooling and services.

Working within a collaborative, multi-disciplinary team, you will provide technical guidance, conduct security reviews, evaluate new technologies, and build solutions that improve the security posture of a complex AWS platform.

The work is varied and fast-paced, spanning security reviews, proof-of-concept activities, tooling development, operational support, and stakeholder engagement.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide security consultancy and technical guidance to platform and engineering teams.
  • Conduct security assessments and reviews of cloud services, applications, and tooling.
  • Design, develop, and maintain security tooling and services using AWS-native and open-source technologies.
  • Investigate, evaluate, and prototype new tools and security capabilities.
  • Support teams in adopting secure engineering practices and making effective use of platform security services.
  • Respond to technical queries and provide expert advice on cloud security matters.
  • Contribute to the operation and continuous improvement of CI/CD pipelines and automation capabilities.
  • Support and mentor less experienced engineers, helping to build capability across the organisation.


Essential Skills & Experience:

Cloud & Security

  • Strong experience securing AWS environments.
  • Hands-on knowledge of AWS security services, including:
  • GuardDuty
  • Security Hub
  • AWS Config
  • Service Control Policies (SCPs)
  • Experience building, managing, and operating cloud infrastructure in AWS.


Automation & Infrastructure

  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
  • Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Knowledge of containerisation technologies, particularly Docker.
  • Experience working with version control systems such as Git.


Software Engineering
Strong coding skills in Python.

  • Experience writing, testing, troubleshooting, and refactoring code using object-oriented principles.
  • Understanding of scripting using Bash.
  • Exposure to Golang and/or Java would be advantageous.


Tooling & Technology
Experience with some or all of the following:

  • AWS
  • Terraform / Terragrunt
  • Jenkins
  • Docker
  • Git
  • Bitwarden
  • Python
  • JSON
  • YAML
